The '''Trandoshan Army''' was an [[Army/Legends|army]] associated with the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Prior to the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="GB" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the Trandoshan [[Slaver/Legends|enslaver]] [[Pekt]] hired former members of the Army to assist him in [[Death/Legends|exterminating]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], a species the Trandoshans had an ancient rivalry with. Pekt and his partners could allegedly clear a village of Wookiees in less than a [[Standard week/Legends|week]].<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Trandoshan Army was mentioned in Pekt's DataBank entry in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.<ref name="GB" />
